subject: DI01000081

body.en:
Understand the idea

Electrostatics studies charges at rest and their electric fields.An electric field E gives force per unit positive test charge:E=F/q.

Explanation and application

  • Charge is in C,force in N,and E in N/C or V/m.Field direction is the force direction on a small positive test charge.
  • Permittivity epsilon=epsilon0 epsilonr describes medium response.Relative permittivity is dimensionless;it is not resistance.
  • Displacement flux density D=epsilon E in a linear isotropic medium has unit C/m².Potential difference relates to work per charge;for a uniform parallel-plate field magnitude E≈V/d.
  • Dielectric strength is the field level a material can withstand under specified conditions before breakdown;actual rating also depends on geometry,defects and environment.
Do opposite charges repel?

No.They attract;like charges repel in the point-charge model.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Electrostaticsમાં સ્થિર charges અને તેમના electric fieldsનો અભ્યાસ થાય છે.Electric field E એટલે positive test chargeદીઠ force:E=F/q.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Chargeની unit C,forceની N અને Eની N/C અથવા V/m છે.Small positive test charge ઉપર forceની દિશા fieldની દિશા છે.
  • Permittivity epsilon=epsilon0 epsilonr mediumનો response બતાવે છે.Relative permittivity dimensionless છે;તે resistance નથી.
  • Linear isotropic mediumમાં D=epsilon Eની unit C/m² છે.Potential difference chargeદીઠ work સાથે સંબંધિત છે.Uniform parallel-plate fieldમાં magnitude E≈V/d.
  • Dielectric strength specified conditionsમાં breakdown પહેલાં સહન કરી શકાય એવો field છે.Actual rating geometry,defects તથા environment પર પણ આધારિત છે.
Opposite Charges Repel કરે?

ના.Opposite attract કરે છે;point-charge modelમાં like charges repel કરે છે.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

For point charges in a uniform medium,F=|q1q2|/(4pi epsilon r²) along their joining line.Like signs repel;unlike signs attract.

How to apply it

  1. Convert microcoulombs to coulombs and separation to metres.
  2. Use centre-to-centre point separation and the stated medium permittivity.
  3. Calculate force magnitude,then assign attraction/repulsion separately from charge signs.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Point-charge approximation,uniform medium and electrostatic conditions matter.For several charges add forces as vectors,not unsigned magnitudes.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Uniform mediumમાં point charges માટે F=|q1q2|/(4pi epsilon r²),તેમને જોડતી line પર લાગે છે.Same signs repel અને unlike signs attract કરે છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Microcoulombને coulombમાં તથા separationને metreમાં ફેરવો.
  2. Point-modelનું centre-to-centre separation અને stated mediumની permittivity લો.
  3. પહેલાં magnitude ગણો;પછી signs મુજબ attraction/repulsionની દિશા બતાવો.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Point-charge approximation,uniform medium તથા electrostatic conditions જરૂરી છે.ઘણા charges માટે force vectors add કરો,unsigned magnitudes નહિ.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

q1=+3microC,q2=−2microC,r=0.30m;approximate vacuum k=9×10⁹N m²/C².

Step-by-step solution

  1. F=(9×10⁹×3×10⁻⁶×2×10⁻⁶)/(0.30²)=0.60N

Interpretation and check

The force is attractive because charges have opposite signs.Doubling separation quarters its magnitude.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

q1=+3microC,q2=−2microC,r=0.30m;vacuum માટે approximate k=9×10⁹N m²/C² લો.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. F=(9×10⁹×3×10⁻⁶×2×10⁻⁶)/(0.30²)=0.60N

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Opposite signs હોવાથી force attractive છે.Separation બમણું કરતાં magnitude ચોથો ભાગ થાય છે.

body.en:
Definition

Capacitance C=Q/V expresses charge separation per unit voltage for a specified geometry and medium;unit farad.

Classification / representative type

  • Classify by dielectric:air,ceramic,mica,film/paper,electrolytic;by adjustment:fixed/variable;by polarity:polarised/nonpolarised.These bases are distinct.

Construction — part and purpose

  1. Two conductive electrodes provide separated surfaces for opposite plate charges.
  2. Dielectric between electrodes prevents ordinary direct conduction and affects capacitance.
  3. Plate overlap area defines how much field-coupled surface is available.
  4. Separation/spacers maintain the intended field geometry without electrode contact.
  5. Terminals connect the two electrodes to the external circuit.
  6. Package/insulation and rating markings protect the structure and identify safe voltage/polarity limits.

Working — sequence and reason

  1. An initially uncharged capacitor is connected through a suitable resistance to a DC source in the model.
  2. External conduction transfers charge so one plate has excess and the other deficient charge;charges do not normally cross an ideal dielectric.
  3. The separated charges establish an electric field in the dielectric.
  4. Dielectric polarisation changes the field response and capacitance for the geometry.
  5. As capacitor voltage rises,the resistor current decreases toward zero in the ideal DC steady state.
  6. Energy remains in the field;real capacitors leak and require verified safe handling even after source isolation.

Applications

Filtering/decoupling,timing,coupling and energy storage when type/ratings suit the circuit.

Limitations and safety

Voltage rating,polarity,ESR,leakage,temperature and stored charge limit use.Never test with mains or assume discharge from an open switch.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Specified geometry અને medium માટે C=Q/V voltageદીઠ charge separation દર્શાવે છે;unit farad છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / દર્શાવેલો પ્રકાર

  • Dielectric મુજબ air,ceramic,mica,film/paper,electrolytic;adjustment મુજબ fixed/variable;polarity મુજબ polarised/nonpolarised.આ જુદા classification bases છે.

Construction — ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

  1. બે conductive electrodes opposite charges માટે અલગ surfaces આપે છે.
  2. Electrodes વચ્ચેનું dielectric ordinary direct conduction રોકે છે અને capacitanceને અસર કરે છે.
  3. Plate overlap area field-coupled surface કેટલી છે તે નક્કી કરે છે.
  4. Separation/spacers electrodesને અડવા દીધા વગર intended field geometry રાખે છે.
  5. Terminals બે electrodesને external circuit સાથે જોડે છે.
  6. Package/insulation structure protect કરે છે અને markings voltage/polarity limits ઓળખાવે છે.

Working — ક્રમ અને કારણ

  1. Modelમાં initially uncharged capacitor યોગ્ય resistance મારફતે DC source સાથે જોડાય છે.
  2. External conductionથી એક plate પર excess અને બીજી પર deficient charge થાય છે;ideal dielectricમાંથી charges સામાન્ય રીતે પસાર થતા નથી.
  3. અલગ થયેલા charges dielectricમાં electric field સ્થાપિત કરે છે.
  4. Dielectric polarisation geometry માટે field response અને capacitance બદલે છે.
  5. Capacitor voltage વધતાં resistor current ઘટીને ideal DC steady stateમાં zero તરફ જાય છે.
  6. Energy fieldમાં રહી શકે છે;real capacitorમાં leakage હોય છે અને source isolate થયા પછી પણ verified safe handling જરૂરી છે.

ઉપયોગ

Type/ratings યોગ્ય હોય ત્યારે filtering/decoupling,timing,coupling અને energy storage.

મર્યાદા અને સલામતી

Voltage rating,polarity,ESR,leakage,temperature તથા stored charge limits છે.Mainsથી test ન કરો અને switch open એટલે discharged ન માનો.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Ideal parallel plates give C=epsilon A/d neglecting fringing.Stored energy is W=CV²/2=Q²/(2C).

Explanation and application

  • Increasing overlap area or permittivity raises C;increasing separation lowers C if other conditions remain unchanged.
  • For a linear capacitor,C is not simply increased by raising its applied voltage.Real dielectric behaviour can make measured C voltage/temperature dependent.
  • Capacitance value does not specify safe working voltage.A small capacitance at high voltage can store hazardous energy.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Fringing અવગણતાં ideal parallel plates માટે C=epsilon A/d.Stored energy W=CV²/2=Q²/(2C) છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Other conditions unchanged હોય તો overlap area/permittivity વધતાં C વધે છે;separation વધતાં C ઘટે છે.
  • Linear capacitorમાં voltage વધારવાથી C સીધું વધતું નથી.Real dielectricને કારણે measured C voltage/temperature પર આધારિત હોઈ શકે છે.
  • Capacitance valueથી safe working voltage નક્કી થતું નથી.High voltageએ નાનું C પણ જોખમી energy store કરી શકે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Choose the dielectric and construction for circuit requirements,not only the printed capacitance.

Explanation and application

  • Ceramic:metal electrodes separated by ceramic dielectric;common for decoupling.Some grades are stable,while others change C substantially with voltage/temperature.
  • Mica:mica dielectric between electrodes;useful for stable small capacitance/precision or suitable high-frequency circuits;cost and available size matter.
  • Film:thin plastic film with foil/metallised electrodes,often wound;timing/filter/pulse use depends on film grade and rating.
  • Paper:treated paper dielectric with foil electrodes,often impregnated;historical/appropriate specialised use requires attention to moisture,ageing and ratings.
  • Electrolytic:very thin oxide dielectric with an electrolyte-based electrode system gives large C per volume.Many are polarised;reverse voltage may cause failure.
  • Variable air/trimmer:movable plates change effective overlap or dielectric position;used for adjustment/tuning rather than general bulk energy storage.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

ફક્ત printed C પરથી નહિ,circuitની જરૂરિયાત મુજબ dielectric તથા construction પસંદ કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Ceramicમાં metal electrodes વચ્ચે ceramic dielectric હોય છે;decouplingમાં સામાન્ય છે.કેટલાક grades stable છે,બીજામાં voltage/temperatureથી C વધારે બદલાય છે.
  • Mica electrodes વચ્ચે dielectric તરીકે હોય છે;stable small C/precision અથવા suitable high-frequency circuitsમાં ઉપયોગી છે.Cost અને size limits હોય છે.
  • Filmમાં thin plastic dielectric સાથે foil/metallised electrodes હોય છે,ઘણીવાર wound હોય છે.Timing/filter/pulse use grade/rating મુજબ થાય છે.
  • Paper typeમાં treated paper અને foil electrodes,ઘણીવાર impregnation સાથે હોય છે.Moisture,ageing,ratings ધ્યાનમાં રાખીને historical/specialised use થાય છે.
  • Electrolyticમાં very thin oxide dielectric તથા electrolyte-based electrode systemથી volumeદીઠ મોટું C મળે છે.ઘણા polarised હોય છે;reverse voltageથી failure થઈ શકે છે.
  • Variable air/trimmerમાં movable platesથી overlap અથવા dielectric position બદલાય છે.Adjustment/tuning માટે છે,general bulk energy storage માટે નહિ.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

C=100microF,V=12V;ideal capacitor initially uncharged.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Q=CV=100×10⁻⁶×12=0.0012C=1.2mC
  2. W=CV²/2=(100×10⁻⁶×144)/2=0.0072J=7.2mJ

Interpretation and check

Stored energy is not CV².In simple resistor charging from zero,the source delivers CV²,half stored and half dissipated.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

C=100microF,V=12V;ideal capacitor શરૂઆતમાં uncharged છે.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Q=CV=100×10⁻⁶×12=0.0012C=1.2mC
  2. W=CV²/2=(100×10⁻⁶×144)/2=0.0072J=7.2mJ

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Stored energy CV² નથી.Zeroથી simple resistor chargingમાં source CV² energy આપે છે,અડધી store અને અડધી dissipate થાય છે.

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

Parallel capacitors share voltage and their capacitances add;series capacitances combine by reciprocal sum under the defined ideal network.

How to apply it

  1. Parallel:Ceq=C1+C2+…;total supplied charge is the sum of branch charges.
  2. Series:1/Ceq=1/C1+1/C2+…;for two,Ceq=C1C2/(C1+C2).
  3. Initially uncharged series capacitors with isolated internal node receive equal-magnitude incremental charge;Vk=Q/Ck,so smaller C gets larger voltage.
  4. Preserve initial-charge conditions and voltage ratings;unequal leakage changes long-term real series voltage sharing.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Do not swap capacitor and resistor rules.Parallel C exceeds each member;series Ceq is below the smallest positive C.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Parallel capacitorsમાં voltage same હોય છે અને C add થાય છે;defined ideal series networkમાં reciprocal sum થાય છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Parallelમાં Ceq=C1+C2+…;total charge branch chargesનો sum છે.
  2. Seriesમાં1/Ceq=1/C1+1/C2+… અને બે માટે Ceq=C1C2/(C1+C2) લો.
  3. Initially uncharged series capacitorsના isolated internal nodeમાં equal-magnitude incremental charge મળે છે;Vk=Q/Ck મુજબ smaller C ઉપર larger voltage આવે છે.
  4. Initial-charge conditions અને voltage ratings જાળવો.Unequal leakageથી real seriesમાં long-term voltage sharing બદલાય છે.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Capacitor અને resistor rules ઉલટાં ન કરો.Parallel C દરેક કરતાં મોટું અને series Ceq નાના positive C કરતાં ઓછું છે.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

Initially uncharged C1=6microF,C2=3microF in series across12V;ideal isolated internal node.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Ceq=(6×3)/(6+3)=2microF
  2. Q=Ceq V=24microC
  3. V1=24/6=4V;V2=24/3=8V;V1+V2=12V

Interpretation and check

For parallel connection of the same values,Ceq=9microF and both see the supply voltage.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને ધારણાઓ

Initially uncharged C1=6microF,C2=3microF,12V ઉપર series છે;internal node ideal isolated માનીએ.

ક્રમબદ્ધ ઉકેલ

  1. Ceq=(6×3)/(6+3)=2microF
  2. Q=Ceq V=24microC
  3. V1=24/6=4V;V2=24/3=8V;V1+V2=12V

અર્થ અને ચકાસણી

Same values parallel હોય તો Ceq=9microF અને બન્ને ઉપર supply voltage આવે છે.

h.en: General RC response and time constant
h.gu: General RC Response અને Time Constant

body.en:
Statement and physical meaning

For a linear first-order RC network with positive seen resistance R,vc(t)=Vf+(Vi−Vf)e^(−t/RC),tau=RC.Vi is initial voltage and Vf the final DC value.

How to apply it

  1. Choose the capacitor-voltage reference;finite nonimpulsive current cannot instantly change vc,so vc(0+)=vc(0−).
  2. Find initial/final voltages from the pre/post-switch circuits;use the resistance seen by the capacitor after switching.
  3. Charging from zero toward Vs:vc=Vs(1−e^(−t/tau)),i=(Vs/R)e^(−t/tau).
  4. Discharging Vi through R:vc=Vi e^(−t/tau).With current referenced into the positive plate,i=−(Vi/R)e^(−t/tau).
  5. At tau,charging reaches63.2%of its total change;discharge retains36.8%.At5tau,about0.674%of the original difference remains.
  6. Draw voltage and current curves with axes,initial/final values and tau;charging current decays although voltage rises.

Validity and common mistakes

  • Five time constants is an engineering approximation,not exact zero or a safety certificate.Measure residual voltage with approved methods;real leakage,tolerance and meter loading alter results.
body.gu:
વિધાન અને ભૌતિક અર્થ

Positive seen resistance Rવાળા linear first-order RC networkમાં vc(t)=Vf+(Vi−Vf)e^(−t/RC),tau=RC.Vi initial અને Vf final DC voltage છે.

લાગુ પાડવાનો ક્રમ

  1. Capacitor-voltage reference પસંદ કરો.Finite nonimpulsive currentમાં vc instantaneously બદલાતું નથી;vc(0+)=vc(0−).
  2. Pre/post-switch circuitsમાંથી initial/final voltages શોધો;switch પછી capacitor પરથી દેખાતું resistance લો.
  3. Zeroથી Vs તરફ chargingમાં vc=Vs(1−e^(−t/tau)),i=(Vs/R)e^(−t/tau).
  4. Viને R મારફતે discharge કરતાં vc=Vi e^(−t/tau).Current positive plateમાં પ્રવેશતો reference હોય તો i=−(Vi/R)e^(−t/tau).
  5. Tau પર charging total changeના63.2%સુધી અને discharge36.8%remaining થાય છે.5tau પછી original differenceના આશરે0.674%બાકી રહે છે.
  6. Axes,initial/final values અને tau સાથે curves દોરો.Chargingમાં voltage વધે છે છતાં current ઘટે છે.

શરતો અને સામાન્ય ભૂલો

  • Five time constants engineering approximation છે,exact zero/safety certificate નહિ.Approved methodથી residual voltage તપાસો.Leakage,tolerance અને meter loading result બદલે છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

The exponential shape describes the remaining difference from the final state,not a constant voltage increase per second.

Explanation and application

  • Initially uncharged charging:vc begins at0 and approaches Vs;current begins at Vs/R and approaches0.
  • Discharge:voltage begins at Vi and approaches0;the physical discharge-current direction is opposite to the charging reference.
  • Tau has seconds because ohm×farad=second.Larger R or C makes the ideal response slower.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Exponential shape final state સુધીનો remaining difference દર્શાવે છે;દર secondએ same voltage વધારો થતો નથી.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Initially uncharged chargingમાં vc0થી Vs તરફ જાય છે;current Vs/Rથી0 તરફ ઘટે છે.
  • Dischargeમાં voltage Viથી0 તરફ જાય છે;physical discharge current charging referenceની વિરુદ્ધ છે.
  • Ohm×farad=second હોવાથી tauની unit seconds છે.R અથવા C મોટું હોય તો ideal response ધીમો થાય છે.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Choose current into the capacitor positive plate as the fixed reference for both charging and discharging.

Explanation and application

  • Charging from zero:i begins at+Vs/R and decays toward0;it does not rise with the capacitor voltage.
  • Source-free discharge from Vi:i begins at−Vi/R in this same reference and approaches0 from the negative side.
  • At one tau,the magnitude of either exponential is about36.8%of its own initial value;different I0 normalisations do not imply equal physical currents.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Charging તથા discharging બન્ને માટે positive plateમાં પ્રવેશતો current fixed reference લો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Zeroથી chargingમાં i,+Vs/Rથી શરૂ થઈ0 તરફ ઘટે છે;capacitor voltageની સાથે વધતો નથી.
  • Same referenceમાં source-free dischargeનો i,−Vi/Rથી શરૂ થઈ negative sideથી0 તરફ આવે છે.
  • One tauએ exponential magnitude પોતાના initial valueના આશરે36.8%થાય છે.Juda I0 normalisations એટલે physical currents equal હોવા નહિ.

body.en:
Given and assumptions

R=10kohm,C=100microF,Vs=12V;initial vc=0.

Step-by-step solution

  1. tau=10000×100×10⁻⁶=1s
  2. vc(1s)=12(1−e⁻¹)≈7.585V;i(0+)=12/10000=1.2mA
  3. After discharge from12V for1s:vc=12e⁻¹≈4.415V
  4. At5s discharge:vc≈0.0809V for the ideal model
